entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I'm calling about an order. I'm just so disappointed. I need to make a return.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item?

It's the Pro-Series jersey I bought a while back. I finally tried it on for a big ride I was planning, and it's just the wrong size. It's so much smaller than I expected... it's just way too tight. I feel terrible, I've been a loyal customer for years and I've never had this happen.
I understand, that can certainly be frustrating when you're looking forward to using new gear. It sounds like a sizing preference issue rather than a defect, is that correct?
Yes, I suppose so. I just... I really needed this to work out. With everything going on, I was hoping to get my money back. I saw it was a bit ago that I ordered it, and I'm worried I'm too late.
Let's take a look. I don't want you to worry. Do you have the order number handy?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. The jersey was delivered 83 days ago. Let me just confirm our current policy.

Alright, I have good news. For a standard item like this jersey, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 83, you are well within the window. We can absolutely process this for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you so much.
Of course. We can either process a full refund back to your original payment method, or I can help you set up an exchange for a larger size if you'd prefer. What works best for you?
A refund would be wonderful, thank you. You've really made my day.

I'm happy I could help. And I see here you're one of our VIP members. We really appreciate your loyalty. As a thank you, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee. I'm also adding a 15% discount code to your account for your next purchase, just in case you decide to try that jersey in the correct size later on.
Wow, David. That is incredibly kind. I didn't expect that at all. Thank you. This is why I stick with VeloFit.

It's our pleasure. I've just sent the prepaid return label to the email on file. Just package the jersey, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thanks again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
